moves.name: Follow a Path
moves.triggerShort: When you journey along a known route, and one day blends into the next.
moves.trigger: When you journey along a known route, and one day blends into the next, roll +supply.
moves.strong: You reach your destination and the situation favors you. Take +1 momentum.
moves.weak:
You complete the journey, but face a cost or complication. Choose one or more:
  • You took longer than expected.
  • You pressed on through pain, sickness, or weariness: Endure Harm.
  • You suffered under the burden of foul weather, worries, or fearful locations: Endure Stress.
  • You wasted resources.
  • You face a complication or hazard at the destination. Envision what you find (Ask the Oracle if unsure).
moves.miss: You are waylaid by a dire threat, and must Pay the Price. If you overcome this obstacle, you may push on safely to your destination.
moves.notes: A bonus move adapted from Set a Course (Starforged), itself adapted from Escape the Depths (Delve). It resolves a journey across familiar lands in one roll — travel with uncertainty and risk, but not the full focus of a usual journey; especially useful for the return leg of a round trip. When traveling with allies, let each member of the company suffer one or more weak-hit costs as appropriate. Such are the hardships of the road.

moves.name: End the Fight
moves.triggerShort: When you take decisive action to resolve the outcome of this fight.
moves.trigger: When you take decisive action to resolve the outcome of this fight, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll. If you do not have initiative, count a strong hit as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss.
moves.strong: This foe is no longer in the fight. They are killed, out of action, flee, or surrender as appropriate to the situation and your intent (Ask the Oracle if unsure). Vanquish Foe
moves.weak:
As above. Vanquish Foe But you must also choose one:
  • It's worse than you thought: Endure Harm.
  • You are overcome: Endure Stress.
  • Your victory is short-lived: A new danger or foe appears, or an existing danger worsens.
  • You suffer collateral damage: Something of value is lost or broken, or someone important must pay the cost.
  • You'll pay for it: An objective falls out of reach.
  • Others won't forget: You are marked for vengeance.
moves.miss: You have lost this fight. Pay the Price.
moves.notes: The Lodestar alternate to End the Fight, adapted from Starforged's flexibility. Unlike the base move, you may make this progress roll without a strong hit on a preceding decisive action, and regardless of initiative — but at greater risk of failure: if you do not have initiative, count a strong hit as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss. Momentum is ignored on this roll.
